rationale: The task is an explicitly read-only readiness pre-check in an existing repository. It requests inspection rather than a change, formal artefact, approval, or implementation, so AGDF routes it as a Quick Task.
decision_grounds: The router assigns questions, small reviews, local inspection, and other read-only work without new product semantics to
The task is explicitly scoped as read-only and asks only to pre-check OpenCode provider and agent readiness.
No durable approval or Brownfield decision is required for this ungated inspection.
No file mutation, product semantics, architecture, policy, persistence, or release-critical work is requested.
